document.abstract: Although hardware technology has made the film and video post-production industry more creative and has greatly improved the speed at which many job functions are performed, there still exists the “subjective” aspect within a film-to-tape telecine session. The Gamma & Density “Thorough Control System” has had a dramatic positive impact on affecting the degree of such subjectivity.
